chunks: And they say: 'When is this promise, if you are truthful?'
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers ask about the timing of the resurrection?
ai.summary: In Surah Saba, this verse captures the impatient skepticism of the Quraysh, who demanded a specific timeline for the resurrection to test the prophets' sincerity. Shia exegesis highlights this as a recurring motif of 'istitraq' (hastening) the punishment, illustrating how doubt often manifests as a demand for immediate proof rather than reflection on the divine promise.
